python3 - << 'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime
paths = [
    "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl",
    os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
    "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl",
]
for p in paths:
    print("\n===== ", p, "exists", os.path.exists(p))
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        continue
    n = 0
    with open(p) as f:
        for line in f:
            if "2026-10-08" not in line and "2026-10-07" not in line:
                continue
            n += 1
            if n > 40:
                print("...truncated")
                break
            try:
                o = json.loads(line)
            except Exception:
                print(line[:300])
                continue
            # compact
            keys = list(o.keys())[:12]
            ts = o.get("ts") or o.get("time") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("at") or ""
            src = o.get("source") or o.get("kind") or o.get("from") or ""
            text = o.get("text") or o.get("content") or o.get("summary") or o.get("prompt") or ""
            if isinstance(text, dict):
                text = json.dumps(text, ensure_ascii=False)[:200]
            text = str(text).replace("\n"," ")[:180]
            bid = o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or o.get("reply_to") or ""
            print(f"{ts} | {src} | {bid} | {text}")
    print("matched_lines_shown", n)
PY
